name: manual_3d7fc6
claim: A git push to GitHub over HTTPS can fail transiently with a connection timeout (exit 128, 'Failed to connect to github.com port 443') even with valid credentials and no actual network outage -- retry the exact same push once before treating it as a real auth or connectivity problem

decisions.notes: Hit this twice this session on otherwise-successful commits; a plain retry succeeded both times with no other change, confirming it was transient rather than a real credential or network issue.
